scenarios.title: Fixed eight-scenario selection and isolated service process execution, including billing and generation with explicit local runtime capture
plannedActions: Invoke the journey selector with one supported name and an unknown name using isolated stub processes, including one failing process.
expectedOutcomes: Only the requested fixed service journey is launched in an isolated process; unsupported names fail and process failures propagate.

scenarios.title: Launch an isolated automation app session with a specified executable and invalid launch options
plannedActions: Launch an isolated automation app session with a specified executable and invalid launch options.
expectedOutcomes: A valid launch yields an isolated session and invalid launch parameters fail without controlling another app.

scenarios.title: Start an automation session with the optional coverage observer enabled and disabled
plannedActions: Start an automation session with the optional coverage observer enabled and disabled.
expectedOutcomes: The observer attaches only when requested and its absence does not block launch.

scenarios.title: Complete session launch and send an automation command
plannedActions: Complete session launch and send an automation command.
expectedOutcomes: The command routes to the launched session after readiness.

scenarios.title: Invoke CLI help, a valid journey and invalid app paths, then terminate the session
plannedActions: Invoke CLI help, a valid journey and invalid app paths, then terminate the session.
expectedOutcomes: Help includes service journeys, invalid paths are rejected and owned processes are terminated.

scenarios.title: Finish coverage before terminating a session
plannedActions: Close an owned coverage-observed CLI session while recording collector and process events; repeat with a forced finish failure.
expectedOutcomes: A coverage finish is attempted before termination. The owned process still terminates on finish failure and that failure is not described as a successful profile.

scenarios.title: Relaunch a live persistent session before closing
plannedActions: Launch an owned persistent session, settle all commands, relaunch while live and inspect persisted state, then close. Attempt relaunch after close and separately wait for an unmet condition.
expectedOutcomes: Live settled relaunch preserves the intended workspace, post-close relaunch is refused, and an unmet wait times out.

scenarios.title: Export and verify a source manifest
plannedActions: In a disposable isolated source tree export the CLI source manifest to a location outside the tree, and verify it against its pinned digest.
Independently alter eligible file contents, add/remove an eligible file, introduce a symlink, or supply a different manifest digest and rerun verification.

In the same isolated source fixture with private .tracer audit storage, request an export using --include .tracer; assert exit2 and no output manifest. Recheck the ordinary exact eligible source manifest without including private storage.
expectedOutcomes: An unchanged matching manifest verifies; altered content, eligible set, forbidden symlink or digest fails the relevant verification.
The base commit is producer-declared and the manifest does not attest to an executable or a running scenario.
Private .tracer storage is excluded from the valid eligible source set; explicitly requesting it is refused without creating the requested output.

scenarios.title: Record observed command completion
plannedActions: Enable owned coverage observation, issue one successful command, one failing command and one timed-out command; inspect recorded completion metadata and the actual state separately.
expectedOutcomes: Observation records returned success versus failure or uncertainty. A timeout does not prove that a mutation failed to occur.
